description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Details of new Chairman for the Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election results for a local government position (Chairman of Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. It specifically details the elected official's name and the electoral process, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers election results, declarations, and electoral matters.
